DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 玄関のことで、不安を感じられたのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You felt uneasy about something at your entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ドアの横に、昨日は見なかった小さなシールがあります。誰が貼ったか分かりません。狙われている印だと友人に言われて、相談に来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 玄関の未知シールと友人の指摘による不安を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: There is a small sticker beside my door that I did not see yesterday. I do not know who put it there. A friend told me it means I am being targeted, so I came to ask for advice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain your concern about an unfamiliar sticker at your entrance and your friend's comment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: シールの意味は、それだけでは判断できません。貼られた時刻をご覧になったわけではないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: We cannot determine what the sticker means from that alone. You did not actually see when it was put there, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。誰かが貼るところは見ていません。今朝七時に見つけ、まだはがさず写真を撮りました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 貼付は未目撃で朝七時発見と未剥離写真を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Correct. I did not see anyone putting it there. I found it at seven this morning and took a photo without peeling it off.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you did not witness it being attached, found it at seven this morning, and photographed it without removing it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お写真を拝見できますか。建物の管理者にも、確認なさいましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: May I see the photo? Have you also checked with the building manager?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この写真です。管理者へ連絡しましたが、返事はまだです。工事の表示かもしれませんが、それも確かではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 写真と管理者返答未着を示し工事表示とも断定しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here is the photo. I contacted the manager, but have not received a reply yet. It might be a construction marker, but that is not certain either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the photo, explain that the manager has not replied, and avoid assuming it is a construction marker. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 分かることと分からないことを分けて伺います。ドアや鍵に、ほかの変化はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will ask about what is known and what is still unknown separately. Have you noticed any other changes to the door or lock?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 鍵やドアには、見た限りでは壊れた所はありません。気になったのは、このシールです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 鍵やドアに見える破損はなくシールが相談対象と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: As far as I can see, neither the lock nor the door is damaged. This sticker is what concerned me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that there is no visible damage to the lock or door and that your concern is the sticker. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その状況を記録します。管理者から説明があった場合は、その内容もお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will record that situation. If the manager gives you an explanation, please let us know what they say as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 説明が来たら伝えます。今は写真、見つけた時刻、まだ分からない貼った人のことを、こちらでお話しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 管理者返答を追加共有し現時点の事実と不明を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will pass on any explanation I receive. For now, I will explain the photo, the time I found it, and the fact that I still do not know who put it there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will share the manager's reply and explain the facts currently known and unknown. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: この内容を相談担当へ引き継ぎます。それでは、こちらの担当に詳しくお話しください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will hand this information over to the consultation officer. Please explain the details to this officer. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 荷物の送り方をご相談ですね。中身を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like advice on sending a parcel. Please tell me what is inside.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ガラスのコップを贈ります。店で包装してもらったので、包みを開けずに送りたいです。紙の袋のまま持って来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 包装済ガラスコップを紙袋で未開封発送したいと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am sending a glass drinking cup as a gift. The shop wrapped it, so I would like to send it without opening the wrapping. I brought it in a paper bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about sending a wrapped glass cup unopened in a paper bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 紙袋だけで送る前に、外箱と中の保護を整える必要があります。コップは、店の小箱に入っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Before sending it in just a paper bag, you need an outer box and protection inside. Is the cup in a small box from the shop?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 小箱に入っています。ただ、紙袋の中では箱が動きます。包装紙を守ることと、コップを守ることは別ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 小箱が紙袋で動き包装保護と内容保護が別だと認識する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is in a small box. But the box moves around inside the paper bag. Protecting the wrapping paper and protecting the cup are separate things, aren't they?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the small box moves inside the paper bag and acknowledge that protecting the wrapping and the contents are different. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 小箱を外箱の中で動きにくくする方法をご確認ください。こちらで使える外箱もご覧になれます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check how to keep the small box from moving inside an outer box. You can also look at the outer boxes available here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 外箱を一つ買いたいです。小箱を押してつぶさないよう、すき間を埋める物も必要か聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 外箱購入と小箱をつぶさない隙間固定を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like to buy one outer box. I also want to ask whether I need something to fill the gaps without pressing on and crushing the small box.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to buy an outer box and secure the gaps without crushing the small box. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この箱なら小箱が入ります。保護材で固定した後に、もう一度梱包の状態をご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: The small box will fit in this one. After securing it with protective packing material, please ask us to check the packing again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この外箱にします。今日はまだ送らず、家で保護材を用意して入れ直してから持って来ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 当日発送をやめ保護材で梱包して再来する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will take this outer box. I will not send it today; I will prepare protective material at home, repack it, and bring it back.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide against sending it today and say you will return after packing it with protective material. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お戻りの際も、中身はガラスのコップとお知らせください。包装をしただけで破損を防げるとは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: When you return, please tell us again that it contains a glass cup. Wrapping alone does not necessarily prevent breakage.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ガラスと伝えます。贈り物の包みは保ちたいですが、紙袋だけで急いで出さず、外箱と固定を整えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 中身ガラスを告げ紙袋のみで急がず箱と固定を整える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will tell you it is glass. I want to keep the gift wrapping intact, but I will prepare an outer box and secure it instead of rushing to send it in just a paper bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will disclose the glass contents and prepare a box and secure packing without rushing to send it in just a paper bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 外箱はこちらです。それでは、ご準備の後にお待ちしております。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here is your outer box. We will look forward to seeing you once it is ready. Have a safe trip home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お振込みの金額について、ご質問ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a question about the amount to transfer?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 請求書は八千円です。手数料は別に払うと聞きましたが、その分を八千円から引いて入力するのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 請求八千円から手数料を引いて入力するか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: The invoice is for 8,000 yen. I heard that I pay the fee separately, but should I subtract it from the 8,000 yen when entering the amount?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether to subtract the fee from the invoiced 8,000 yen when entering the amount. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 相手へ送る金額と、銀行へ払う手数料は分けて確認します。相手から、差し引いてよいとの指示はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check the amount sent to the recipient separately from the fee paid to the bank. Has the recipient instructed you that you may deduct it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ありません。請求書には八千円を払うとだけあります。自分で引いてしまうと、相手には八千円が届かなくなりますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 差引指示なしと引くと請求額不足になることを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: No. The invoice only says to pay 8,000 yen. If I deduct it myself, the recipient will not receive the full 8,000 yen, will they?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm that there are no deduction instructions and that deducting the fee would leave the invoiced amount short. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 手数料の負担について、相手との取り決めは、こちらでは判断できません。指定額の確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: We cannot determine your agreement with the recipient about who pays the fee. You need to confirm the specified amount.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今日は相手へ八千円を送るつもりです。手数料がいくらか分かってから、支払う総額を用意したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 八千円送金を希望し別手数料と総額を知りたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I intend to send the recipient 8,000 yen today. Once I know the fee, I would like to prepare the total payment.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you want to transfer 8,000 yen and know the separate fee and total. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この方法の手数料は三百円です。送金額八千円の場合は、合わせて八千三百円となります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: The fee for this method is 300 yen. For a transfer of 8,000 yen, the total is 8,300 yen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 八千三百円を用意します。振込額の欄は八千円のままにして、手数料三百円はそこから引きません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 八千三百円を用意し送金欄八千円を維持する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will prepare 8,300 yen. I will leave the transfer amount at 8,000 yen and will not deduct the 300 yen fee from it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will prepare 8,300 yen and keep the transfer amount field at 8,000 yen. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 金額のほか、受取先も確認してからお手続きを進めます。請求書をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will check the recipient as well as the amount before proceeding. Do you have the invoice?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 請求書はこちらです。送金先はここに書かれた口座で、送る金額は八千円です。手数料と合わせて八千三百円を用意しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 請求書宛先と送金八千円総額八千三百円で依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Here is the invoice. The destination is the account written here, and the amount to send is 8,000 yen. I have prepared 8,300 yen including the fee.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Request the transfer to the invoice's recipient, specifying 8,000 yen to send and 8,300 yen in total. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、資料と記入内容を確認します。ご準備ありがとうございます。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will check the document and the information entered. Thank you for preparing everything. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お会計の後で、何かありましたか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 持って来た袋の持ち手が切れました。品物はまだこの台の上で、床には落としていません。店の袋を追加で買えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 持参袋の持ち手切れと商品未落下を報告し追加袋を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: The handle on the bag I brought broke. The items are still on this counter and have not fallen on the floor. Can I buy an extra store bag?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that your bag's handle broke but the goods have not fallen, and ask for an extra bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 袋は一枚五円です。中身を移すまで、こちらの台へ置いていただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Bags are five yen each. You can leave the items on this counter until you transfer them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 台へ置きます。瓶が二本あるので、切れた袋を持ち直して歩かず、新しい袋へ分けて入れたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 台へ置いて瓶二本を切れた袋で運ばず分けたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will put them on the counter. There are two bottles, so I would like to divide them between new bags instead of trying to carry the broken bag again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you will put the goods on the counter and divide the two bottles rather than carry them in the broken bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 新しい袋を何枚ご希望でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: How many new bags would you like?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 二枚お願いします。瓶を一本ずつにして、残りのパンは重い瓶の下に入れないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二枚を希望し瓶一本ずつとパンの位置を考える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Two, please. I will put one bottle in each and make sure the remaining bread does not go under the heavy bottles.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for two bags, one bottle in each, and consider where to put the bread. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 二枚で十円です。こちらの袋をお使いください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Two bags cost ten yen. Please use these bags.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 十円はこちらです。袋を受け取ったら、この台で詰め直してもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 袋代十円を払い台で詰め直してよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Here is ten yen. Once I receive the bags, may I repack the items on this counter?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Pay ten yen for the bags and ask whether you may repack on the counter. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: どうぞ。通路にはみ出さないよう、こちらの台をお使いください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Certainly. Please use this counter and keep everything out of the aisle.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二枚へ移せました。台に品物が残っていないことも確認しました。破れた袋は自分で持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 移替え台上残品なしを確認し破袋を持ち帰る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have transferred everything into the two bags. I also checked that nothing is left on the counter. I will take the torn bag home myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the transfer and that no goods remain on the counter, and say you will take the torn bag home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お荷物をご確認いただけました。それでは、お気をつけてお帰りください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: You have checked your belongings. Have a safe trip home. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 雨が降ってきましたね。何かご案内しましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: It has started raining. Can I help you find something?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 散歩の途中で絵を描いていました。紙がぬれる前に道具をしまいたいので、近くの屋根がある場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 雨で紙が濡れる前に写生道具をしまう屋根を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I was sketching during my walk. I want to put my supplies away before the paper gets wet, so please tell me where there is a nearby covered place.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for a covered place to pack up your sketching supplies before the rain wets your paper. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの東屋を使えます。今いる道から、砂利の道へ入らず、左へ進むと見えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can use this gazebo. From the path you are on, go left without entering the gravel path and you will see it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 左の東屋ですね。紙を片づける間、少し使わせてもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 左の東屋を確認し描き続けず片付けだけと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: The gazebo on the left, right? I will use it briefly while I put the paper away.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm the gazebo on the left and say you will only pack up, rather than continue drawing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ほかの方も雨を避けていますので、席を広く取らないようお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Other people are sheltering from the rain too, so please avoid taking up too much seating space.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一席だけでしまいます。紙を押さえながら歩くので、筆や水の容器を先に袋へ入れてから移動します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 一席のみ使用し筆水を先に袋へ入れ移動する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will use just one seat to pack up. I will be holding the paper down as I walk, so I will put my brushes and water container in my bag first, then move.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will use only one seat and put the brushes and water away before moving. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 入口の段差にお気をつけください。雨が強くなった場合の帰り道も、確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please watch the step at the entrance. We can also check your route home in case the rain gets heavier.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 東屋でしまってから北口へ帰りたいです。来た時は園内を一周したので、同じ長い道を戻らなくてよい経路がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 片付け後北口へ一周せず戻る経路を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: After packing up in the gazebo, I would like to leave through the north gate. I walked all the way around the park when I came in; is there a route back that avoids that same long path?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for a route to the north gate after packing up that does not require another circuit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 東屋の正面の舗装された道が、北口へつながります。一周する必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: The paved path directly in front of the gazebo leads to the north gate. You do not need to walk all the way around.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では、東屋で道具をしまってから、北口へ帰ります。近い道を教えてくださって助かりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 短経路を理解し写生散歩を終了して帰ると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I will pack up my supplies in the gazebo and leave through the north gate. Thank you for showing me the shorter route.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show you understand the short route and decide to finish your sketching walk and go home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、入口にお気をつけて東屋へどうぞ。道具をしまわれましたら、お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23224-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please head to the gazebo, watching the entrance. Once your supplies are packed away, have a safe trip home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 掲示板のポスターについて、お尋ねでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about a poster on the noticeboard?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 青い電車の絵のポスターが気に入りました。書かれた催しは先週で終わっていますが、掲示を外した後にもらうことはできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 催しが終了した掲示ポスターを撤去後にもらえるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I like the poster with a picture of a blue train. The event on it ended last week, but could I have the poster after it is taken down?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can have a displayed poster after removal, now that the event has ended. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 催しが終わっていても、掲示物は管理している担当へ確認します。どのポスターか、こちらから教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Even though the event has ended, we need to check with the staff responsible for displayed materials. Can you show me which poster from here?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この右下のポスターです。下に、駅前広場の秋まつりと書いてあります。自分の部屋に飾りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 右下の秋まつりポスターを特定し部屋に飾る目的を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is this poster at the bottom right. At the bottom it says Autumn Festival at the Station Square. I would like to hang it in my room.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Identify the autumn festival poster at the bottom right and explain that you want to display it in your room. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 対象は分かりました。譲渡できるかと、掲示を外す時期を管理担当へ確認するご相談になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: I understand which one. This will be a request to ask the display manager whether it can be given away and when it will be taken down.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いできればうれしいです。もしもらえる場合、受け取りに来る日も担当の方と相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 譲渡できる場合の受取日も管理担当と相談したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would appreciate your help. If I can have it, I would also like to arrange a collection date with the person in charge.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you also want to discuss the pickup date with the manager if the poster can be given to you. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 問合せ先はこちらの紙でご案内します。催しの受付ではなく、駅の掲示管理の担当です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: This paper gives the contact details. It is the station's display manager, rather than the event reception desk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 掲示管理の担当ですね。今はポスターをそのままにして、この紙の連絡先へ相談します。ポスターの名前もメモしておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 駅の掲示管理担当の連絡先を確認し現物は残して題名をメモする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: The display manager, right? I will leave the poster as it is for now and contact the person listed on this paper. I will also note down the poster's title.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the contact for the station's display manager, leave the poster in place, and note its title. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当へ、気に入ったポスターとご希望の用途をお伝えください。ここでは譲渡の可否はまだ決まっていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please tell them which poster you like and how you want to use it. It has not yet been decided here whether it can be given away.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 駅前広場の秋まつりのポスターを部屋に飾りたい、と伝えます。返事を聞いてから、受け取れるかと日時を確かめます。連絡先をありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: ポスター名と飾る目的を担当へ伝え可否と受取日時を返事後に確認すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will say I want to put the Autumn Festival at the Station Square poster in my room. After hearing their reply, I will confirm whether I can collect it and the date and time. Thank you for the contact details.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will tell the manager the poster title and your display purpose, then confirm permission and the collection date and time after their reply. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、掲示管理の担当へお問い合わせください。ご相談ありがとうございました。お気をつけてお出かけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please contact the display manager. Thank you for asking. Take care on your way.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 申込用紙についてのご質問ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a question about the application form?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。点線があるので下を切って捨てようとしましたが、まだ提出前です。切ってよい部分でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 点線下部を提出前に切れるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I saw the dotted line and was about to cut off and discard the bottom, but I have not submitted it yet. Is that a part I may cut off?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can cut off the part below the dotted line before submitting it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: そこは受付後にお渡しする控えの部分です。今は切らず、そのままお出しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: That is the receipt section we give you after accepting the application. Please submit it intact without cutting it now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 控えなのですね。注意書きのおまけと思っていました。下にも私の名前を書く欄があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 下は控えで氏名欄もあると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: So it is my receipt. I thought it was just some extra notes. There is also a field for my name at the bottom.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm that the lower part is the receipt and also has a name field. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 上下の記入欄は、両方お確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check the fields on both the upper and lower sections.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 上は書きましたが、下は空欄です。必要な欄を記入してから、上下をつないだまま出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 下欄を記入し連結用紙のまま提出する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I filled in the top, but the bottom is blank. I will fill in the required fields and submit it with the two sections still attached.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will fill in the lower fields and submit the form with both parts attached. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご提出の際に、受付で確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: The reception desk will check it when you submit it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 下の部分は、受付が終わってから返していただけるのですね。返されたら大切に持っておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 下部の控えは受付後に返されると確認し保管すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: The lower part will be returned to me after the application is accepted, right? I will keep it safe when it is returned.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm that the lower receipt is returned after acceptance and say you will keep it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。控えは受付後のご案内になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. We will explain about your receipt after accepting the application.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。点線はまだ切らず、下の欄も書きます。受付が終わったら、返された控えを持って帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 切らず記入して受付後返された控えを持帰る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will not cut along the dotted line yet, and I will fill in the bottom too. After the application is accepted, I will take the returned receipt home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will leave it uncut, fill it in, and take home the receipt returned after acceptance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、記入した用紙をお持ちください。ご確認ありがとうございました。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please bring the completed form. Thank you for checking. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 血圧を測りますので、腕をこちらへお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: I will take your blood pressure. Please put your arm here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 右の肩が痛く、その高さまで腕を上げにくいです。測る時の姿勢を相談できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 測定前に右肩痛で腕を上げづらいと申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: My right shoulder hurts, and it is hard to raise my arm to that height. Could we discuss the position for the measurement?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Before measurement, report right shoulder pain and difficulty raising your arm. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 痛む側を教えていただいてありがとうございます。今の姿勢でどの辺りが痛みますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Thank you for telling me which side hurts. Where does it hurt in your current position?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 右肩の上です。腕を机へ載せようとすると痛みが強くなります。座っているだけなら、少し楽です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 右肩上部で挙上時増強座位では楽と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: At the top of my right shoulder. The pain gets worse when I try to put my arm on the desk. Just sitting is a little more comfortable.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the upper right shoulder hurts more when raised and feels easier while sitting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 測定の姿勢をこちらで確認します。今は腕を無理に動かさないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check your position for the measurement. Please do not force your arm to move for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: このまま待ちます。今の姿勢から、腕をどう置けばよいか案内していただけると助かります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 無理に動かさず待ち測定時の腕の置き方の案内を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will wait like this. It would help if you could tell me how to place my arm from my current position.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will wait without forcing movement and ask for instructions on placing your arm for measurement. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 肩の痛みについて、診察でもご相談されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Will you also discuss your shoulder pain during the consultation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。今日相談したい内容です。血圧の時だけ痛かったわけではなく、家で着替える時も痛みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 診察対象の痛みで自宅着替え時にもあると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. That is something I want to ask about today. It did not only hurt during the blood pressure check; it also hurts when I change clothes at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say the pain is a reason for the consultation and also occurs when changing clothes at home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その状況も診療担当へお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will pass that situation on to the clinician too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。机へ腕を上げにくいことと、着替えでも痛むことを伝えてから、案内された姿勢で測ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二場面を担当へ伝え指示姿勢で測定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I will explain the difficulty raising my arm to the desk and the pain when changing clothes, then have the measurement in the position you instruct.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain both situations to the clinician and have the measurement in the instructed position. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、姿勢を確認いたします。しばらくお待ちください。お大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will check your position now. Please wait a moment. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 自転車のライトが点かないというご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you here because your bicycle light is not working?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ライトが付かなくなりました。もう暗いので、乗って帰ってよいか分からず、ここで止まりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 暗くなって故障ライトで走らず相談に止まったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: The light has stopped working. It is already dark, and I was unsure whether I could ride home, so I stopped here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you stopped to ask for advice instead of riding with a broken light after dark. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 点かないまま走り出さず、安全な帰り方をご検討ください。修理できる所へ連絡できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please consider a safe way home without setting off while the light is not working. Can you contact somewhere that repairs bicycles?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 近くの修理店へ電話しましたが、今日はもう閉まっていました。明日、修理を相談するつもりです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 修理店は閉店しており翌日の修理相談を予定していると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I called a nearby repair shop, but it had already closed for today. I intend to ask about repairs tomorrow.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say the repair shop is closed and you plan to ask about repairs tomorrow. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今、ご自宅までどのように移動するつもりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: How do you plan to get home now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 家族に車で迎えを頼みます。自転車は車に載るか分からないので、ここへ勝手に置いて帰らず相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 家族迎車を頼むが無断駐輪せず扱いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will ask my family to pick me up by car. I do not know whether the bicycle will fit in the car, so I want to ask rather than leave it here without permission.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will ask your family for a car pickup and ask about the bicycle instead of parking it without permission. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 自転車を置く場所は、管理している所へ確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check with the place responsible about where you can leave the bicycle.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。置いてよい場所が見つからなければ、乗らずにどう運ぶか家族と考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 許可駐輪がなければ乗らない運搬法を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. If I cannot find somewhere I am allowed to leave it, I will discuss with my family how to transport it without riding it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that if permitted parking is unavailable, you will discuss transporting it without riding. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 暗い道での移動にも、お気をつけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also take care when travelling on dark roads.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 家族へ、ライトが付かず乗っていないと伝えます。迎えだけでなく、自転車の持ち帰り方も確認してから動きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未乗車状況と自転車持帰り法も家族に確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will tell my family that the light is not working and I have not ridden it. Before moving, I will confirm both the pickup and how to bring the bicycle home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm with your family that you have not ridden and how to bring the bicycle home too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、ご家族とご相談ください。お帰りもお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please discuss it with your family. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 宛名の記入はお済みでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you finished writing the recipient's name and address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 途中でペンが出なくなりました。この薄い所はまだ読めますが、名前の最後が書けていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: ペン切れで宛名末尾未完と相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: My pen stopped writing partway through. This faint part is still readable, but I have not finished the end of the name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for help because your pen ran out and the end of the recipient's name is unfinished. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 別のペンをご利用いただけます。宛先は、手元の資料でご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can use another pen. Please check the destination against the document you have.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 友人からもらった住所の紙はこちらです。これを見ながら、借りたペンで続きを書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 友人の住所資料を示し別のペンで続きを記入すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here is the paper with the address my friend gave me. I will continue writing with the borrowed pen while looking at it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the address document from your friend and say you will continue with another pen. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 文字が重ならないように、ご記入ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please write without overlapping the letters.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 同じ線を何度もなぞると汚れそうです。まだ書いていない名前の最後を、空いた所へはっきり続けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 重ねなぞりを避け未記入部分を明瞭に書く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Tracing the same lines repeatedly may make a mess. I will clearly continue the unwritten end of the name in the space available.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Avoid repeatedly tracing the letters and write the unfinished portion clearly. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 住所の方は、最後まで書かれていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you written the address all the way to the end?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 建物名までは書きましたが、部屋番号が抜けています。今、紙と見比べて気づきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 照合で建物後の部屋番号抜けを発見して伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I wrote as far as the building name, but left out the room number. I just noticed while comparing it with the paper.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you found the missing room number after the building name when checking the document. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 部屋番号もお確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check the room number too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 部屋番号と名前の最後を書けました。薄い文字も読めるか見直してから、封筒を出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 番号と氏名末尾を完成し可読確認後提出する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have written the room number and the end of the name. I will check that the faint letters are readable too before handing over the envelope.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Finish the number and the end of the name, check readability, then submit it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、こちらへお出しください。ご記入ありがとうございました。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23225-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please hand it in here. Thank you for filling it in. Goodbye.
